test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A alone can paint a house in 35 days and B alone can do it in 70 days. Along with C, they did the job in 10 days only. In how many days C alone can do the job?
solution:
**Detailed solution:- **

1 day’s work of A = 1/35

1 day’s work of B = 1/70

Let C alone can do the painting job in x days

According to the question,

⇒ 1/35+ 1/70 + 1/x = 1/10

⇒ 3/70 + 1/x = 1/10

⇒ 1/x = 1/10 - 3/70 = 4/70

⇒ x = 70/4

**∴ C alone can do the painting job in __70/4__ days.**
